name: Beta admin — export all data (JSON download)
gap: No beta export. Settings does ship a real full-backup JSON download, but it is the whole store, not the four beta collections.

name: Beta admin — "Sync All to Server Now"
gap: No beta sync button. Settings' Sync now is the only sync-shaped control and it has no server behind it.

name: Notification preference — Rest timer
gap: The preference is stored under lk_notifPrefs, but nothing is scheduled: a page cannot fire a rest-timer notification later without a service worker, and the card says so.

name: Notification preference — Training day + send time
gap: The workout switch and a single Reminder time row are both stored, but nothing is scheduled and the time is one global value, not per notification type.

name: Notification preference — Daily check-in + send time
gap: There is a check-in notification switch and a Daily check-in frequency row, but no send time for the check-in and nothing scheduled.
where: settings.html:770 checkin options, settings.html:284 NOTIF checkin

name: Notification preference — Unfinished workout
gap: No 'unfinished workout' notification preference in the NOTIF list.

name: Notification preference — Supplements
gap: The supplements preference exists and is stored; nothing is scheduled.

name: Notification preference — Compounds
gap: No compounds notification preference (Stack has no reminder row in NOTIF).

name: About Me — Height (cm, or ft + in)
gap: Height is a single centimetres field. There is no ft + in entry even when the weight unit is pounds — the row prints 5 ft 6 in but the editor only takes cm.

name: Daily check-in frequency (1 / 2 / 4 per day)
gap: The row offers Off / Morning / Evening / Morning and evening and writes lk_checkinPerDay (0/1/1/2), not v6's 1 / 2 / 4, and the Coach check-in pane never reads the key — it still allows exactly one a day.

name: Fuel display settings card (hide numbers, dashboard framing)
gap: "Show calorie numbers" survives and Fuel honours it, but the Left/Eaten dashboard framing was cut: "Fuel display preferences (hide calories, Left/Eaten). Settings for a screen belong on that screen" (settings.html:97).

name: Nutrition CSV / JSON export and full-account backup/restore
gap: Meal CSV, full JSON backup and a real file-picker restore all work; the CSV carries no weight-log table and the restore has no merge/overwrite choice or timestamp-skip.

name: Cycle-tracking opt-in sync
gap: No lk_mcCloudSync flag and no opt-in path; lk_cycle only gates whether the cycle surface is shown.

name: Deploy-version check / cache bust
gap: Settings’ Force refresh clears Cache Storage and reloads, on demand and honestly labelled; there is no /app-version fetch, no lk_deployVersion and no automatic check on load.

name: Service worker registration
gap: No service worker file and no registration; Settings states the consequence at the point of use — "Sending one later, when the app is closed, needs a service worker, and this build has none: nothing here is scheduled."

name: Deploy-version check and cache bust
gap: Only the manual half: Settings’ Force refresh clears Cache Storage and reloads. There is no version fetch on load, no lk_deployVersion and no automatic bust.

name: Deploy-version cache bust
gap: Manual only: Force refresh clears Cache Storage and reloads. No /app-version fetch, no lk_deployVersion comparison and no automatic bust on load.
